pairs.registryProposal: test-harness now has 25 techniques. Most of them are suite or lane scoped (history-driven-partitioning, flake-lifecycle, long-lane-certification, mutation-lane, out-of-graph-artifacts, configuration-axes), so for a single test context the half-of-techniques floor means about 13 anchors, mostly not-applicable ones. That makes conformant effectively unreachable per context: two prior conformant verdicts in this run (commands-contest, db-repos) fell to unknown with no defect found. Proposal: tag each technique with a scope (context or lane), or count the floor over context-scoped techniques only.
